identificationModule.briefTitle: Chemotherapy and Lapatinib or Trastuzumab in Treating Women With HER2/Neu-Positive Metastatic Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Open-Label, Phase III Study of Taxane Based Chemotherapy With Lapatinib or Trastuzumab as First-Line Therapy for Women With HER2/Neu Positive Metastatic Breast Cancer

interventions.name: trastuzumab
interventions.description: IV q weekly (loading dose 4mg/kg; subsequent doses 2mg/kg) or IV q 3 weekly (loading dose 8mg/kg, subsequent doses 6mg/kg).

interventions.name: docetaxel
interventions.description: 75mg/m2 IV q 3 weekly, day 1 of a 3 week cycle for 8 cycles plus G-CSF (when given together with lapatinib).

interventions.name: lapatinib ditosylate
interventions.description: 1250 mg once daily (while given with taxane). 1500mg once daily (when given alone after taxane completion).

interventions.name: paclitaxel
interventions.description: 80mg/m2 IV q weekly days 1, 8 and 15 of a 4-week cycle for 6 cycles.
